storyCards.headline: Where Do You Go: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
No Mercy's "Where Do You Go" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 39 weeks on the chart.

Where Do You Go was released in 1996.
